_comment: Do the two engine classes behind the hidden refusals depend on the checkpoint the whole
campaign quotes, or on the emulator? Four runs: the census checkpoint (1,500 seeds, three
disjoint shards), a second act1 arm, a later checkpoint of the same arm, and a different
stage (floor6) with a different seed partition and depth window. Same predicates, same

capacity_pattern.note: the shop mask and one event's own mask arm test capacity as 'any of the three slots is empty', which AddPotion (min(2, len) slots) cannot honour; the two '!= 0' sites are a different question -- 'does the player hold a potion' -- and match their step arms (verified row by row for events 31 and 35).

established: both classes reproduce on every run: potion-capacity refusals appear in all 6 runs and event refusals in all 6, with native 1602/1602 refused bases advertised by the engine's own mask
this repo's expansion is clean in every run: flat mask wider than native on 0 of 348,890 decisions, executed actions outside the native mask 0

the class MIX is not stable, so a single per-episode refusal rate is not a transferable number: the act1 census is shop-heavy (641 potion vs 112 event) while floor6, whose episodes are shorter and event-denser, is the reverse (43 potion vs 292 event, 273 of them refused option indices the event's arm never handles)

the phantom slot is not confined to shops: 10 refusals across these runs are event id 7 (TheLegendsWereTrue) option 1 -- an event the mask switch DOES handle, whose own arm advertises a potion when any of three slots is empty (RunEngine.cs:3519) while its step calls AddPotion (RunEngine.cs:2263). 10/10 carry the exact slot signature (two full, third empty); hp is not in the row schema so the PlayerHp > 8 clause was not checked
the capacity test appears at 2 mask sites and both contradict AddPotion, so the fix is a pattern, not a line
not_established: that the mix is stage-driven rather than checkpoint-driven: floor6 differs from act1 in both stage and checkpoint, so which of the two moves the ratio is not separated here
any behaviour of a policy trained toward these states -- these are evaluations of existing checkpoints under the 2026-09-02 freeze
the PlayerHp > 8 clause of event 7's arm, for the reason above
